faq.title: Before you ask — here's what everyone wants to know
faq.description: Clear answers before you migrate your first client.

items.question: What if my client needs WooCommerce?
items.answer: We don't migrate WooCommerce stores — that's a different product category. Akash Engine is optimized for service businesses: dental clinics, law firms, restaurants, consultants, agencies. If it's a store, stay on WooCommerce.

items.question: Will my client's SEO tank?
items.answer: No. We preserve every URL, generate 301 redirects for changed slugs, migrate all meta tags and schema, and submit updated sitemaps. Most clients see SEO improvements within 30 days because their Core Web Vitals finally pass.

items.question: What CMS does the client get?
items.answer: emdash — a modern headless CMS with a WordPress-familiar editing experience. Clients can update text, images, and blog posts without calling you. It's what WordPress should have been in 2025.

items.question: How is hosting free forever?
items.answer: We deploy to Cloudflare Pages — their free tier includes unlimited sites, unlimited bandwidth, global CDN, and automatic SSL. Cloudflare's business model is enterprise customers. Your client's site is essentially free infrastructure forever.
